name: P4-A matched coded readout evaluation, independent supplement
role: Development follow-up to the interrupted Antigravity LLR calibration. Preserves the signed readout and is separate from the sealed P4-D confirmatory families.

train.objective: Original _train_comparative_model with signed (.035,20) readout, under native P4-A training schedule. All readout alternatives subsequently share identical model weights.

evaluation.channel: 32 tones, 16 CP, static equal4, 4x Rapp oversampling, pilot and payload through original simulator, independent draws across fit groups and conditions; both architectures and all settings share every received sample within group and condition.
evaluation.fec: One actual (128,64) systematic word per frame, 25-iteration normalized min-sum with alpha=.75.
evaluation.metrics: Integer erroneous blocks, decoded info bits, uncoded bits, paired frame failure indicators, summed BCE, max |LLR| and count with |LLR|>8. Descriptive diagnostic. Positive off-minus-on BLER is improvement; report all conditions, signs and ties. Reuse across architectures does not create additional independent frames.
evaluation.controls: Native payload pipeline parity; syndrome, waveform sharing and noiseless soft decoder control; bit-for-bit public signed LLR control for every batch. Reproduce archived 2026 group native uncoded 10/30 dB strong PA counts for both architectures.
